params.prompt: A storybook painting. A wide vista of a hilltop lookout at night under the Moon: a stone terrace with a low balustrade and a small white lighthouse tower with one warm lit window, a telescope on a tripod pointed at the sky, a few warm string lights. Below, the city lights spread along a dark wide river, painted as soft dots of warm color. Low in a deep petrol-blue and indigo sky, a thin crescent Moon lying on its back like a smile, with the rest of its disc faintly visible in a soft gray glow (earthshine). The student looks through the telescope and the cat sits on the balustrade. Night shadows are deep blue and teal, never black; the lamp light is warm orange. Foreground framed by the dark silhouette of the balustrade and a flowering bush. Tiny in the frame, less than one tenth of the image height: the young engineering student from the first reference image (voluminous dark curly hair, warm brown skin, khaki jacket and cargo pants, brown crossbody bag) and her small gray-taupe cat from the second reference image (cream face and paws, blue collar with a small cyan round tag). Use the references only for their design and colors, and paint both with a few gouache brush strokes in the same style as the scene. Painted as a full-bleed plate from a hand-made illustrated storybook: traditional gouache and transparent watercolor on textured cold-press paper, visible brush strokes, soft wet-in-wet washes with the paper grain showing through, simplified flat shapes with loose painterly edges, very few small details, large calm areas. Restrained warm palette of cream, ochre, terracotta, muted tropical green and petrol-blue shadows; shadows are colored, never black; low saturation. Strong atmospheric perspective: the far distance is pale, hazy and bluish with almost no detail, and only the focal area is a little crisper. Composition in three layered planes like a paper theater: a dark, simple silhouette framing the foreground, the lit middle ground, and a pale background. Matte and handmade: no glossy highlights, no bloom, no lens flare, no light rays, no 3D render look, no digital sharpness, no hyper-detail. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no flags. No text, no logos, no interface.
